verdict.rationale: Open-source licensing is a fair question for a product analytics and digital-adoption platform, since open-source competitors exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Pendo publishes its source under an open license. Its JavaScript snippet, SDKs, public APIs and MCP server are integration surfaces, not open-licensed source code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
